## 8c6b703c91e5

**Canonical-fitting shortcut — always overwrite a reflected target.** A rival
that reflects each orange 7 across the gray divider and paints blue 1 even when
the target is already nonzero fits all five public pairs: none has a decoration
on a reflected target. The intended rule preserves an occupied target.

The current random sampler can emit a counterexample but does not schedule one.
Across a deterministic audit of 250 four-demo lessons (1,000 distinct inputs),
only 101 lessons refuted the rival; it survived all four demonstrations in 149.
The finite sample uses seeds `7001+lesson`, indices `lesson*4..+3`, and cycles
bands. Evidence: `checks/audit/8c6b703c91e5/overwrite-shortcut.json`.

An exact generated witness (seed 7003, sample index 10) contains a reflected
orange whose target is already decorated. The supported canonical Racket runner
preserved that decoration, matched the independent intended output, and disagreed
with the overwrite rival. Evidence:
`checks/audit/8c6b703c91e5/racket.json`. The semantic gate also reports
`NO_CONTRACT`, so there is no executable lesson guarantee for this rival:
`checks/audit/8c6b703c91e5/semantic_gate/checks/8c6b703c91e5_before_semantic_gate.log`.

triage.reason: Both adversarial findings, source-bound reproducers and notes retained; unrelated audit targets unchanged.
